title: Build and verify the quadcopter's datasheet
instruction: This quadcopter has no datasheet yet. Produce its datasheet (HTML and PDF in docs/), verified against the model, and tell me the all-up mass and the docId the datasheet states. Only the datasheet: leave the assembly guide as it is.

graders.description: the answer reads the figures from the document

graders.rubric: A datasheet's bound values for a 5-inch 6S quadcopter. 1. Every value has a status (source, derived, model, assumption, measured, stand-in, or gap: a value the model does not state, shown as the gap marker — and listed for the model's author, as the uhd-tech-docs skill requires instead of a typed value) and derived values name their formula and inputs. 2. The displayed values (`text`) carry units that are SI or conventional for the field (V, mAh, A, g, kg, mm); the `unit` metadata fields are written by the generator, not the agent. 3. No value is a placeholder (TBD, NaN, undefined, an empty string); a gap marker is not a placeholder. 4. Stand-in test data, if any, is labelled as such, not as measured. 5. Key figures a buyer needs are present: all-up mass, battery voltage and capacity, thrust, peak current.

solution.say: Built docs/quadcopter-5in-datasheet.html and .pdf (docId UHD-QUAD5-DS) and verified them against the model: 0 errors. The datasheet states an all-up mass of 587 g.
